description: This file declares the ControlClientServerInternal class, which implements the IControlClientServerInternal interface for IPC communication within the Rialto server component. It includes method declarations for notifying application state and pinging, and manages an IPC client and control ID.

classes.name: ControlClientServerInternal
classes.description: Implements IPC control client server internal logic, managing control ID and IPC client reference.

methods.name: ControlClientServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing control ID and IPC client reference.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Notifies the application state via IPC.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message via IPC.
